name: Should I Buy It
description: Thinking of buying something? Your AI helps you decide with honest questions, pros and cons.
prompt: Help decide whether to buy something: describe the item, price and why you want it, and Acornix.askAI asks a couple of honest questions and gives a balanced verdict with pros, cons and a wait 48 hours suggestion, with a list of past decisions.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: ¿Piensas comprarte algo? Tu IA te ayuda a decidir con preguntas sinceras, pros y contras.
